# ShotStudio

> ShotStudio turns three raw mobile screenshots into a polished three-shot App Store set in under a minute. One-time pay, no subscription, never stored. Built for indie iOS developers who don't want to spend a weekend in Figma the night before submission.

## What it does
- Input: 3 raw mobile screenshots (PNG/JPEG, up to 10 MB each), an app name, a one-sentence pitch, and an iOS App Store category.
- Output: 3 PNGs at 1290×2796 (iPhone 6.7" portrait spec) — sRGB, no transparency, no watermark. One polished device-framed shot per uploaded source screen.
- Time: ~1 minute per set.
- Headline copy is AI-written from the user's pitch and audience.
- Style: 4 curated presets (soft bright, dark premium, clean minimal, bold playful), auto-picked from the chosen category.

## Pricing (one-time, no subscription)
- Starter — $7 USD for 2 generation sets.
- Growth — $17 USD for 5 generation sets (most chosen).
- Studio — $37 USD for 12 generation sets.
- 1 credit = 1 set = 3 polished images (one per user-uploaded source screen). Credits never expire.
- Credits are refunded automatically only when image generation fails after our retry/fallback path is exhausted.
- Tax calculated at checkout via Stripe Tax.

See full structured pricing: /pricing.md
Public pricing page: /pricing

## Privacy
- Zero image persistence: uploads pass through memory to the AI model, then are dropped. No images table, no S3 bucket, no thumbnail cache.
- Generated images are returned to the user's browser only and are unrecoverable once the tab closes.
- No third-party analytics or advertising cookies.
- Sub-processors: Clerk (auth), Stripe (payments), Supabase Postgres (account/transaction data only — never images), Upstash Redis (idempotency), OpenRouter / OpenAI (image generation), Resend (email), Vercel (hosting).
- Privacy policy: /privacy

## Who it's for
- Solo iOS developers, indie hackers, two-person studios, freelancers shipping client apps.
- First-time App Store submitters and existing apps refreshing screenshots after a feature launch.

## Who it's NOT for (v1)
- Android / Google Play developers (no Play export in v1).
- Large brands or agencies needing pixel-precise brand-guideline compliance.
- Teams (no team accounts, no shared credits).
- Anyone wanting persistent generation history (intentionally not built).
